name: plunk
label: Plunk
description: Open-source email platform for transactional emails, marketing campaigns, and contact management.

secretKey.label: Secret API Key
secretKey.description: Used for /v1/send, /v1/contacts, and the Custom API Call action.

publicKey.label: Public API Key
publicKey.description: Required only for the Track Event action.

send_transactional_email.label: Send Transactional Email
send_transactional_email.description: Send a transactional email through Plunk. Recipient can be a single address or a comma-separated list.

to.label: To
to.description: Recipient email address. For multiple recipients, separate with commas.

name.label: Sender Name
name.description: Optional sender name. Falls back to the project default.

from.label: Sender Email (From)
from.description: Optional sender email. Must be a verified address on your Plunk project.

subscribed.label: Mark Recipient as Subscribed
subscribed.description: When enabled, Plunk creates the recipient as a subscribed contact if they do not already exist.

get_contact.label: Get Contact
get_contact.description: Retrieve a single contact by ID.
